reason: Limit milestone-based drawdown conditions to measurable company-controlled milestones.

proposed_change.old_text: - Drawdown linked to achieving specific, measurable financial milestones, such as reaching a set monthly recurring revenue (MRR) or completing a product launch phase.
proposed_change.new_text: Milestone-linked drawdown may be accepted only where milestones are measurable, within company control, and automatically satisfied once supporting evidence is delivered.
